title: 2004 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Monkey
seo_title: 2004 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Monkey (22 January – 8 February 2005)
description: 2004 is the Year of the Wood Monkey (Yang, Jia-shen), from 22 January 2004 to 8 February 2005. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2004.
lead: Born in 2004? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Monkey, but check the date: the 2004 Wood Monkey year began on 22 January 2004. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2004: Year of the Wood Monkey, from 22 January 2004 to 8 February 2005.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2004 was the Year of the Monkey. It began with Lunar New Year on 22 January 2004 and ended on 8 February 2005, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2004 ends in 4, which makes it a Wood year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2004 is a Jia-shen year. The same Wood Monkey combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1944 before it and 2064 after it.
Lunar New Year 2004 fell on 22 January 2004. Anyone born from 1 January 2004 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Goat; from 22 January 2004 on, the Monkey.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Monkey guide describes the sign like this: “Clever, curious, and witty. Monkeys are quick learners who enjoy solving problems creatively.” The usual watch-out: “Can be mischievous or struggle to focus on one thing.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Monkey page.
Careers often linked with the Monkey: technology, marketing, comedy, consulting.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2004
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Monkey's best matches are the Rat, Dragon and Snake, and its clash sign is the Tiger, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Monkey years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1980 (Metal Monkey); 1992 (Water Monkey); 2016 (Fire Monkey); 2028 (Earth Monkey). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2004 is the Year of the Monkey, a Yang Wood Monkey year (Jia-shen).
When does the 2004 Year of the Monkey start and end?
It starts on 22 January 2004 and ends on 8 February 2005.
I was born in January 2004. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 22 January 2004, you are a Goat; from 22 January 2004 on, a Monkey.
Wood. 2004 ends in 4, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Monkey compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Dragon and Snake. The Monkey's clash sign is the Tiger.
